build_sdpa_backend: build an SDPABackend instance to use torch scaled_dot_product_attention as the attention backend for sglang
create_sdpa_impl: create an SDPAImpl with num_heads, head_size, causal flag, and softmax_scale for attention computation
get_supported_head_sizes: get the list of supported head sizes (32, 64, 96, 128, 160, 192, 224, 256) from SDPABackend
get_sdpa_enum: get the AttentionBackendEnum value for SDPABackend to identify the backend type
run_sdpa_forward: run the forward pass of SDPAImpl with query, key, value tensors and attention metadata
